Class AppointmentController

java.lang.Object
edu.oosd.restservices.RestApi.controllers.AppointmentController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/appointments") public class AppointmentController extends Object
REST controller for managing appointments in the scheduling system.

Provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting appointments. Supports filtering by doctor or patient with time ranges such as today, this week, this month, past, and future appointments. Conflict detection prevents double-booking for both doctors and patients.

Base URL: /appointments

    • getAppointmentsForDoctorThisWeek

      @GetMapping("/doctor/{doctorId}/week") public List<Appointment> getAppointmentsForDoctorThisWeek(@PathVariable Integer doctorId)
      Retrieves all appointments for a specific doctor within the current week (Sunday through Saturday).

      Uses TemporalAdjusters to compute the boundaries: rolls back to the most recent Sunday and forward to the nearest Saturday.

      Parameters:
      doctorId - the unique ID of the doctor
      Returns:
      a list of Appointment records for the current week

    • createAppointment

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> createAppointment(@RequestBody Appointment appointment)
      Creates a new appointment after validating there are no scheduling conflicts.

      Conflict checks are performed before saving: first for the doctor, then for the patient. If either has an overlapping appointment, the request is rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict. The creation timestamp is set automatically.

      Parameters:
      appointment - the Appointment object to create, provided in the request body
      Returns:
      201 Created with the saved appointment, or 409 Conflict with an error message if a scheduling clash is detected

    • updateAppointment

      @PutMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateAppointment(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestBody Appointment appointment)
      Fully replaces an existing appointment by ID after validating scheduling conflicts.

      Overlap checks exclude the appointment being updated so it does not conflict with its own previous time slot. Returns 404 if no appointment exists with the given ID. The update timestamp is set automatically.

      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the appointment to update
      appointment - the updated Appointment data from the request body
      Returns:
      200 OK with the updated appointment, 404 Not Found if the appointment does not exist, or 409 Conflict if a scheduling clash is detected

    • updateAppointmentField

      @PatchMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Appointment> updateAppointmentField(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestBody Appointment partial)
      Partially updates an existing appointment's fields by ID.

      Only non-null fields in the request body are applied to the existing record. Supported fields: date, startTime, endTime, patient, and doctor. Note: this method does not perform conflict checking on partial updates.

      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the appointment to patch
      partial - an Appointment object containing only the fields to update
      Returns:
      200 OK with the patched appointment, or 404 Not Found if the appointment does not exist
